svg.text: Writing one 512-token story (4 chunks of 128 tokens): how many steps must run one after another?
plan: first G levels attend across all chunks
local levels: each chunk on its own
halo: sees 4 positions of each neighbour
sequential steps (time) → one bar = one parallel pass; AR row compressed
Batch size 1, one RTX 5050 laptop GPU, TinyStories. Block-NCM: G=5 global levels + halo 4. AR: TinyStories-33M.
More chunks keep the same 11 passes: 0.39 s for 256 tokens, 0.38 s for 1,024 tokens.
